query:
UPDATE mcguildlink.audit_outbox
                     SET needs_attention = $2,
                         next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(secs =>
                             LEAST(3600.0, 60.0 * power(2.0, LEAST(retry_count, 6)))),
                         retry_count = LEAST(retry_count, 2147483646) + 1
                     WHERE log_id = $1
